critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~430 line file — fine at MVP size, no split needed yet.

server.py cashback engine: `random.randint(1, max_cb)` where max_cb=max(1, floor(amount*rate*0.5)); for very small amounts (e.g. electricity ₹100 → floor(100*0.015*0.5)=0 → clamped to 1), min-of-1 guarantee holds ✓.
verify-otp deletes on max attempts but does NOT rate-limit /auth/request-otp — a caller can spam OTP endpoint. Non-blocking for MVP but flag for prod.
PIN lock at 5 fails is permanent until manual reset (no cooldown or admin unlock). Consider auto-unlock after N minutes.
compute_max_cashback returns int but scratch card `amount` is used as float in wallet crediting — works but consider consistent type.

success_rate.frontend: ~55% — auth, PIN setup, home, wallet, rewards, profile render OK; service screen (recharge/bill flow) is completely broken which blocks scratch/cashback UI flow

seed_data_creation: Each test/UI run provisions a fresh mobile-OTP user (unique 10-digit phone) with PIN=4321 to avoid state collisions. No global seeding required.

rca_of_issue: Reproduction: (1) open web preview, (2) enter any 10-digit phone e.g. 9130119185, (3) OTP 1234, (4) set PIN 4321, (5) on Home tap Mobile tile → red screen 'Element type is invalid ... got undefined. Check the render method of `ServiceScreen(./service/[type].tsx)`.' Bisect attempt: replaced `Bank` (deprecated alias) with `BankIcon`+local alias — did NOT fix, so `Bank` is not the undefined import. Remaining suspects (in priority order): (a) `GradientButton variant="gold"` at line 184 — if variant is unsupported it might return undefined element; (b) something inside `plansFor(service.type)` returning null (unlikely – array); (c) icon `Circle` name collision (phosphor exports Circle correctly, verified). Main agent should log each phosphor named import at the top of service/[type].tsx to identify the undefined one, then also inspect GradientButton for 'gold' variant handling.
